name: i9_5b_workplace_collect
note: Prior academy setup only; Aquaris comes from initial roster. Work Place crew selection invokes the stock cell touch listeners (unnamed virtual widget). No Work Place/job/mission state is provisioned. Dispatch, mission 10017, show-team and diary run first; relogin-after then waits until the operator has moved the host clock past the 10-hour job (PostgreSQL time is authoritative), and the collection runs the stock TreasureWindow DONE-cell callback body (finishOneTeam then treasure_reward), the populated diary and a relogin.
steps: lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('treasure_window') if not w then error('vc-workplace-no-window') end local m=w.treasureModel if not m.teams[2] then error('vc-workplace-no-team') end xyd.WindowManager.get():openWindow('treasure_prepare',{locationId=2,types={2001},titleName=xyd.tables.treasureLocation:name(2),typeName=2001})

lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('treasure_edit') if not w then error('vc-workplace-edit') end local found=false local function walk(n) if found then return end if n:getName()=='item_bg' then for _,c in ipairs(n:getChildren()) do local ls=c._LuaListeners and c._LuaListeners[cc.NODE_TOUCH_EVENT] if ls then for _,l in ipairs(ls) do l.listener_({name='began'}) l.listener_({name='ended'}) end found=true return end end end for _,c in ipairs(n:getChildren()) do walk(c) end end walk(w:nodeByName('list')) if not found then error('vc-workplace-no-crew-touch') end
lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('treasure_prepare') if not w or #w.heroIds~=1 then error('vc-workplace-selection') end

lua:local m=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.TREASURE) local r=m.teams[2] if not r or r.start_time==0 or #r.partners~=1 then error('vc-workplace-not-dispatched') end local task=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.TASK).tasks[xyd.TaskType.DAILY][10017] if not task or task.count~=1 then error('vc-workplace-mission') end xyd.WindowManager.get():openWindow('treasure_show_team',{locationId=2,types={2001}})
lua:local wm=xyd.WindowManager.get() local w=wm:getWindow('treasure_show_team') if not w or #w.heros~=1 then error('vc-workplace-show-team') end wm:closeWindow(w)
lua:local wm=xyd.WindowManager.get() local w=wm:getWindow('treasure_diary') if not w then error('vc-workplace-diary') end wm:closeWindow(w)

lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('treasure_window') if not w then error('vc-collect-no-window') end local m=w.treasureModel local r=m.teams[2] if not r or r.start_time==0 or #r.partners~=1 then error('vc-collect-not-dispatched-after-relogin') end vc_collect=nil m:finishOneTeam(function(code,data) vc_collect=code if code==xyd.error.OK then xyd.WindowManager.get():openWindow('treasure_reward',{locationId=2,typeName=2001,locationName=xyd.tables.treasureLocation:name(2),reward=data.award}) end end,{teamId=2})

lua:local wm=xyd.WindowManager.get() if vc_collect~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc-collect-code-'..tostring(vc_collect)) end local w=wm:getWindow('treasure_reward') if not w then error('vc-collect-no-reward-window') end wm:closeWindow(w)

lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('treasure_window') if not w then error('vc-collect-window-gone') end w.treasureModel:getTreasureDiary(function(code,data) if code==xyd.error.OK then xyd.WindowManager.get():openWindow('treasure_diary',data or {}) end end)

lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('treasure_diary') if not w then error('vc-collect-diary') end if #w.datas<1 then error('vc-collect-diary-empty') end xyd.WindowManager.get():closeWindow(w)

lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('treasure_window') if not w then error('vc-relog-no-window') end local r=w.treasureModel.teams[2] if r and r.start_time~=0 and #r.partners>0 then error('vc-relog-team-still-dispatched') end
